name: the Flash Brothers

tenures.source: the fed's own served bio page (cross-referenced from the already-served cwfpro archive)
tenures.note: Own bio's own History section, in full: "They were the main tag team in the XXX with Bryan Williams, Bobby Williams and Star but never really got along with them. The 1st XXX was not own by Pres Burns. Untill he bought it in 2003 after it had shut down. He reopened it as a farm efed for the cwf.pro untill he would close it again in 2006." (The "Star" named alongside Bryan/Bobby Williams here is not confidently identified — Jason Star's own bio dates his own XXX involvement to a 2006 developmental contract, after the farm era began, so this row is not given an XXX-first tenure on that loose thread alone.) Their own Earlier Career line separately dates their DEPARTURE from the XXX to 2001 ("They left the XXX efed after talking with R@ven in 2001"), before the 2003 buy this same passage states — read as the same wrestlers' XXX run ending before the promotion itself changed hands, not a contradiction. SOURCES DISAGREE with bobby-williams's own tenure note on the buy date (2003 vs. 2005) — both are recorded, neither resolved. FURTHER, THIS PASS — A DATE THE ACCESSION DID NOT CARRY: their own Earlier Career line ends their independent-XXX run precisely, and names who ended it. "They started out in 1997 as rookies in a few efeds winning minor titles in the PWE, JJP, GWC, & RFP. They left the XXX efed after talking with R@ven in 2001." R@ven is the buyer's own scout (his own served bio: "He was a scouter for the cwf.pro"), and the same page's next section confirms what the talking was for: "They were set to join the CWF-Pro in 2001, but the cwf.pro clsed after the cross over with the tdw." That gives this wing its only firmly dated in-era EVENT of any kind — a departure in 2001, inside the independent XXX's own attested 2000-2003 window, two years before the earlier of the two disputed buyout years. Note also that the four efeds named as their 1997 starting points (PWE, JJP, GWC, RFP) are NOT the XXX; nothing here moves this wing's own founding date earlier than Bobby Williams' own 2000. Every XXX championship credit carried by any of this wing's three roster entities was counted against the five served XXX title ledgers, all of which are dated uniformly "1/2006 - 11/2007" and belong to the post-buyout farm era. EVERY CREDIT RECONCILES EXACTLY, leaving no residue that could belong to the independent promotion: Bobby Williams' own "XXX Champion (3)" against xxx-title.html's reigns 2, 11 and 14; his "XXX 2nd Champion (5)" against xxx-2nd-title.html's reigns 2, 4, 6, 15 and 17; his "XXX Tag Team Champion" against xxx-world-tag-team-title.html's reign 36 (with Jason Star). Bryan Williams' own "XXX Champion (4)" against reigns 1, 8, 10 and 13 — matching that ledger's own summary table, "Most Times as Champion: Bryan Williams, 4 times" — and his "XXX 2nd Champion (2)" against reigns 5 and 10. The Flash Brothers' own "XXX World Tag Team Champions (15)" against that ledger's own summary table, "Most Times as Champions: Flash Brothers, 15 times," and their "XXX 2nd Tag Team Champions (2)" against both of xxx-2nd-tag-team-title.html's own Flash reigns. The independent XXX's own championship record, if it kept one, therefore leaves no trace anywhere in the surviving record — a checked negative, not an unexamined gap.
